name: Example Housing Assistance Scheme (FIXTURE - NOT A REAL SCHEME)
shortDescription: Financial help for eligible low-income women to build or repair a house.
description: This is a made-up scheme used only to test the system. It gives a one-time grant to eligible low-income households in one state to build a basic house. Real schemes must replace this file.

benefits.text: A one-time grant towards building a basic house.

rules.description: All of the following must be true.
Applicant must live in Tamil Nadu.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Household must not already own a house.
Annual household income must be at most 3,00,000 rupees.
Applicant must be widowed/divorced/separated OR have annual household income of at most 1,20,000 rupees.
Annual household income at most 1,20,000 rupees.
None of these exclusions may apply.

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of identity
requiredDocuments.description: A government-issued photo ID. Keep the original with you. Do not share ID numbers or OTPs with anyone who calls you.
requiredDocuments.howToObtain: Apply at the nearest government service centre if you do not have one.

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of address
requiredDocuments.description: A document showing your current address, such as a ration card or electricity bill.

requiredDocuments.name: Income certificate
requiredDocuments.description: A certificate from the local revenue office stating your family's yearly income.
requiredDocuments.howToObtain: Apply at the local revenue office or the e-service centre.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank passbook
requiredDocuments.description: First page of a bank or post-office passbook in your own name.
requiredDocuments.howToObtain: Open a savings account at any bank or post office.

applicationSteps.text: Go to the official website shown on your screen, or visit the nearest government office.
Fill the application form. Ask an officer or a trusted person to help you if needed.
Submit the form with your documents and keep the receipt.
Use the receipt number to check the status later.
